body.message:
Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback with us. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and frustration you have experienced during your stay.

Regarding the security deposit, please note that this requirement is clearly mentioned on the Booking.com platform and is mandatory as part of the check-in process.

As we operate as a holiday home, our working hours are from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Due to security and building regulations, check-in details cannot be shared in advance before the required procedures are completed. We also sincerely apologize for the waiting time during check-in and understand your frustration.

Regarding the amenities, we provide a standard set of facilities as a holiday home, which differs from hotel services. Daily housekeeping, slippers, toothbrushes, and certain consumable items are not included. Additional cleaning can be arranged upon request at an applicable charge.

We also take your concerns regarding the appliances and cleanliness seriously and will share them with the relevant team for review.

Once again, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused. We value your comfort and will do our best to address the concerns and improve your experience for the remainder of your stay.

Thank you for your understanding and feedback.
